designRevision: Use existing durable intent outside Broadcast.write_atomically, with LocalWrite transaction nested inside its callback. Outer durable intent remains outstanding until outer Content commit/deferred flush, even if inner physical ticket checks in. Queue ownership belongs to Broadcast.write_atomically, which commits success and rolls back errors. A with_deferred_queue envelope alone cannot decide whether generic LocalWrite error committed or rolled back Content, so the earlier proposed nesting is superseded before implementation/runtime.

change.helper:
# PRIVATE preparation only. The existing durable intent remains outstanding
  # until the outer Content transaction and deferred delivery complete. The
  # pending-address lock precedes Content and remains through cache invalidation.
  # Filesystem effects cannot be rolled back by PostgreSQL; no atomicity claim.
  defp release_under_database_boundary(doc, file, dataset) do
    key = case file.object_key do
      value when is_binary(value) and byte_size(value) > 0 -> value
      _ -> file.path
    end
    Barkpark.Content.Broadcast.write_atomically(fn ->
      Barkpark.Media.Storage.LocalWrite.run(key, fn ->
        case write_checkout(doc, file, dataset, nil, nil) do
          {:ok, updated} ->
            case invalidate_cache(doc, file, updated) do
              :ok -> {:ok, updated}
              error -> error
            end
          error -> error
        end
      end)
    end)
  end
